creator: NIH NIAID
alt: An anatomical illustration of a hair follicle
description: This functional tissue unit (FTU) illustration includes cell types related to the hair follicle in the ASCT+B Table Skin v1.4. Cell types and measurements were referenced from Yang and Cotsarelis 2010, and Stocum 2012. Uberon describes this FTU as follows: "A tube-like opening in the epidermis where the hair shaft develops and into which the sebaceous glands open." Bibliography: Stocum, David L. 2012. “Regeneration of Epidermal Structures.” In Regenerative Biology and Medicine, 43–65. Elsevier. https://doi.org/10.1016/B978-0-12-384860-4.00003-4 . Yang, Chao-Chun, and George Cotsarelis. 2010. “Review of Hair Follicle Dermal Cells.” Journal of Dermatological Science 57 (1): 2–11. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jdermsci.2009.11.005
caption: Hair-follicle anatomy illustration. It is not an experimental result or evidence of human regrowth.
